title: Possible SQL Injection
detail: SQL query appears to be built with string concatenation/formatting instead of bound parameters.

title: Possible SQL Injection (string-built query)
detail: A SQL statement is concatenated with a variable, allowing attacker-controlled input to alter the query.

title: Hardcoded secret
detail: A credential/secret is hardcoded as a string literal instead of loaded from environment/secret storage.

title: Command Injection
detail: A shell command is executed, and if any part comes from user input this allows arbitrary command execution.

title: Insecure Deserialization
owasp_category: A08: Software and Data Integrity Failures
detail: Deserializing untrusted data with pickle/yaml.load/ObjectInputStream can lead to remote code execution.

title: Dynamic code execution
detail: `eval`/`exec` on data that could be influenced by a user allows arbitrary code execution.

title: Weak cryptographic algorithm
detail: MD5/SHA-1/DES are cryptographically broken for security-sensitive use — use SHA-256+ or bcrypt/Argon2 for passwords.

title: Potential Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
detail: User-influenced content is written directly into HTML/response output without escaping.

title: Debug mode enabled
detail: Running with debug mode on in production can leak stack traces and enable a remote debugger/console.

title: Possible Path Traversal
detail: A file path built from request input without validation could allow reading files outside the intended directory.
